Subject: Request: Room block + accessible suites for VentureCorp offsite (Jun 12-14)

Hi Oliver / Harbor Group Sales team,

We are planning a small executive + engineering offsite for our customer VentureCorp the week of June 12–14 and need to establish a room block and some accessibility allocations. High-level details below — please confirm availability, group rate, and the booking URL/code by EOD Tuesday (May 12) so we can share with the client and lock rooms.

Event basics:
- Group: VentureCorp / Redwood Inference-hosted sessions (approx. 42 attendees)
- Dates: Check-in Fri, Jun 12 — Check-out Sun, Jun 14 (two nights)
- Block request (initial): 40 standard king (single occupancy), 6 double-queen (for assistants), 3 ADA-accessible suites (near elevator), 3 executive suites (for visiting C-suite)
- Arrival pattern: ~12 arriving Thu evening Jun 11 (early arrivals), remainder Fri morning

Accessibility & security notes:
- The 3 ADA-accessible suites must be on the same floor as at least one elevator and have roll-in shower or equivalent.
- Two executive suites will need privacy signage and the ability to restrict housekeeping on request.

Logistics asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm nightly group rate (room + tax) and whether a master account or individual billing is preferred.
2) Provide a single booking URL and group code we can distribute and a cutoff date for individual reservations.
3) Confirm deposit / attrition policy and timeline for a signed contract.
4) Can hotel provide keycards pre-programmed with guest names and a separate set for on-site staff (for privacy of execs)?
5) Shuttle: Do you offer an airport shuttle for arrivals Thu evening (SFO), or should we arrange private transport?

Attached: attendee_manifest_v2.xlsx (draft — names, dietary flags, accessibility needs). The attendee list is still a WIP; final manifest will be provided 10 business days before event.

Thanks — if you need a quick call for details I can jump on a 20-min slot tomorrow morning.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Events & Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah — thanks for the details and the manifest. Happy to host VentureCorp. Quick answers inline: 

Hi Oliver / Harbor Group Sales team,

> Please confirm availability, group rate, and the booking URL/code by EOD Tuesday (May 12) so we can share with the client and lock rooms.

Availability: Confirmed for those dates. We can hold the block you requested (total 52 rooms) with the following preliminary breakdown: 40 King Singles, 6 Double-Queens, 3 ADA-accessible suites (Rooms 520–522, near Tower B elevator), 3 Executive Suites (Rooms 610, 611, 701).

Rates and booking: Nightly rate: $259 (single) / $299 (double-queen) / $429 (executive suite) + applicable taxes. Book via: https://harborsidehotel.com/groupbooking/RedwoodVentureCorp Code: RWINF2026. Cutoff: May 28 for individual reservations. After cutoff, remaining rooms will be released but we hold the suite allocations until Jun 5 pending master manifest.

Deposit / contract: We require a 25% non-refundable deposit on the anticipated pick (or a signed master account with guaranteed payment). Draft contract is attached (harborside-group-contract-draft.pdf). We can hold rates for 30 days following signature.

Keycards & privacy: We can pre-program keycards with guest names for executive suites; we recommend a separate envelope delivered to reception for privacy. Housekeeping flags can be attached to guest folio; we can mark "Do Not Disturb" on request with in-room placards.

Shuttle: Our partner shuttle runs scheduled runs between SFO and the hotel Fri–Sun. For early-arriving VIPs on Thu night, many groups prefer private car service — we can provide local vendor contacts and estimate.

Accessibility: Rooms 520–522 meet ADA roll-in shower criteria; accessible parking and ramp access are on the same level. If the manifest indicates wheelchair vs. mobility-aid specifics we will map exact rooms.

Next steps:
- Please sign and return the attached contract by May 18 if you want to guarantee the block.
- Final master manifest due Jun 2 for suite allocations; individual reservations via group link until May 28.

Call: I have availability Tue 12:30–1:00pm PT if you want to walk the contract.

Best,
